the study of the cerebral potentials that precede voluntary movement in patients with a cerebellar lesion of the right side.
the study of the cortical potentials preceding voluntary finger movements in normal subjects and in patients with focal lesions of the cerebellar cortex.
the study of cortical potentials preceding voluntary movement in patients with cerebellar lesion and with the analysis of the relationship between these potentials and the cerebellar system.
